summary: After upgrading, create an AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR in the same namespace naming existing controller and hub (controller.name, hub.name) and enabling a new EDA; images can be overridden per component but upgrading the operator is recommended.
questions: How do I create the AAP CR for existing controller and hub after upgrading?
Add EDA to an existing controller and hub on OpenShift
Can I upgrade just the controller image without upgrading the operator?

answer_card.title: AAP CR for existing controller and hub
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: aap.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleAutomationPlatform
metadata:
  name: myaap
spec:
  controller:
    name: existing-controller   # from the controller CR
    disabled: false
  eda:
    disabled: false
  hub:
    name: existing-hub
    disabled: false
```
